texto.es: Nos cuentas qué necesitas: un cuarto, los techos, los gabinetes o la casa completa.
texto.en: Tell us what you need: a single room, the ceilings, the cabinets, or the whole house.

texto.es: Rafael visita la propiedad y te da un precio razonable antes de empezar.
texto.en: Rafael visits the property and gives you a reasonable price before starting.

texto.es: Preparación, protección de muebles y acabado prolijo, tal como lo describen nuestros clientes.
texto.en: Prep work, furniture protection and a careful finish, just like our customers describe.

titulo.en: We clean up when we are done

texto.es: Dejamos el lugar de trabajo limpio y revisamos el resultado contigo antes de irnos.
texto.en: We clear out the job site, clean up, and walk the finished work through with you before we go.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el tamaño y el alcance del proyecto; llámanos para una cotización razonable.

texto.es: Repintado completo de cuartos, pasillos y áreas comunes, con protección de muebles y pisos.
texto.en: Full repaints for rooms, hallways and common areas, with furniture and floor protection.

texto.es: Pintura de fachadas, garajes y exteriores, resistente al clima de Florida.
texto.en: Facade, garage and exterior painting, built to hold up to Florida weather.

texto.es: Pintura de techos con acabado parejo, incluyendo zonas con manchas o reparaciones previas.
texto.en: Even-finish ceiling painting, including areas with stains or prior repairs.

texto.es: Renovación de gabinetes y paredes de cocina para darle un aspecto nuevo sin remodelar todo.
texto.en: Cabinet and kitchen wall refresh to give the space a new look without a full remodel.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos igual, la mayoría de nuestros trabajos empiezan como un proyecto a medida.

items.quote: Rafael painted our ceiling today, meeting all our expectations promptly and efficiently. He was knowledgeable, professional, and friendly. We would recommend this company to family and friends.

Rafael did a very thorough and careful job. He paid close attention to detail and, most importantly, cleaned up everything nicely after the work was finished. Very professional and considerate. I'm very satisfied with his work!
Rafael was always here when he said. Job was so well done you can't see where hole was. Cleaned up after and at a reasonable price. I strongly recommend A&G Painting
